# BOOTLEG PTAL

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(sf)
library(rdeck)

# Make font directory available to Shiny server
addResourcePath("font", "font")

mesh_block_sf <- read_sf('sf_input/final_result.gpkg') %>%
  st_transform('wgs84')


```

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar
actionButton("toggle_layer", "Toggle: Total Score / Jobs", class = "btn-primary")
```

:::{.column-page}
```{r}
rdeckOutput("map", width = "100%", height = "500px")
```
:::

```{r}
#| context: server
output$map <- renderRdeck({

   # React to button press
  layer_type <- input$toggle_layer %% 2

  base_map <- rdeck(initial_bounds = st_bbox(mesh_block_sf))


  if (layer_type == 0) {
    # Show total_score
    base_map %>%
      add_polygon_layer(
        data = mesh_block_sf,
        get_polygon = geom,
        get_fill_color = scale_color_quantile(total_score, palette = scales::viridis_pal(), probs = seq.int(0,1,0.1)),
        pickable = TRUE
      )
  } else {
    # Show jobs
    base_map %>%
      add_polygon_layer(
        data = mesh_block_sf,
        get_polygon = geom,
        get_fill_color = scale_color_quantile(jobs, palette = scales::viridis_pal(), probs = seq.int(0,1,0.1)),
        pickable = TRUE
      )
  }


})
```
